init.welcome_desc:
Zero External Dependencies | 100% Native Production Suite

Welcome to the Day-0 Turnkey Onboarding Wizard.
This wizard will guide you through cluster parameters, container provisioning, dynamic node ingestion, and zero-trust key rotation.

Controls:
  • <Tab> / Arrow Keys: Move focus between fields and buttons
  • <Space>: Toggle checklist selection [X]
  • <Enter>: Activate button to proceed to the next step
